name: vscode-codex-usage
description: Show Codex CLI and Claude Code usage side by side in the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: Codex Usage: Show Claude Code Usage
Codex Usage: Show Claude Code More Information

enumDescriptions: Query the Codex API when logged in, otherwise read local rollout files.
Always query the Codex API using the logged-in credential (falls back to rollout files if the query fails).
codexUsage.source.description: Where usage data comes from: live Codex API (online) or local rollout files (offline).

codexUsage.compactStatusBar.description: Show a compact status bar chip (icon + single percent) instead of the full per-window breakdown.

codexUsage.showRemaining.description: Show remaining usage ("% left", counting down from 100%) instead of used usage, like the Codex CLI.

enumDescriptions: Show the usage item on the left side of the status bar.
Show the usage item on the right side of the status bar.
codexUsage.statusBarAlignment.description: Which side of the status bar the usage items appear on.

codexUsage.codexHome.description: Path to the Codex home directory. Empty means use ~/.codex.

codexUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to refresh the status bar, in seconds. Codex usage is re-read every time; Claude Code usage is re-fetched only as often as `#codexUsage.claude.refreshIntervalSeconds#` allows.

codexUsage.lookbackDays.description: How many days back to search for rollout files.

codexUsage.claude.enabled.description: Show Claude Code's 5-hour and weekly plan usage next to Codex usage. The item appears only when Claude Code is signed in with a claude.ai plan (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise).

codexUsage.claude.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: Minimum time between Claude Code usage fetches, in seconds. Anthropic's usage endpoint is rate limited and shared with Claude Code's own `/usage`, so one fetch is shared by all VS Code windows and only happens while a window is focused.
